full_page.content:
1933, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 121 Cont.
July 5th Rey. Mau - 43 - was to be baptized Easter .was not and now hesitates.
Pat & Cath. Quain - Elderly - farmers, nervous.
Little Betty - 11 Episcopelian - cancer
Mrs. Mary Wolak - 38 - mental trouble - daughter candidate in convent ...
Martha DeWitt - 26 - very sick ..
B. J. Sub deacon ... not going back - break down.
Page 122 Page 123
Blank page
July 8 Mrs. - 66 - has invalid daughter, hopes that someone might help to support her ... daughter 44 now ill 25 yrs.
July 8 11:45. . Herman Lorsch - 5 - of 3415 Baldwin - Enrolled in Ser. Mass As'n last Sunday after four major operations - was im- proved next day. Was able on Tuesday to take transfusion of blood without difficulty - Manifest improvement Thursday & Friday - Saturday bad turn - hopes vanish - Drs. plan to use Serum injec- tion at | P.M. Is enrolled at 11:45 a.m. and improves at same time. Then he is injected - sad effects. Boy died at 5.
Jos. Sango ... 49 - 3 yrs. away, had been the support of old parents .....
Mrs. Kelly - fell 5 yrs. ago & broke leg. It never healed. Now about 55 .. ..
Anna Resco - 67 - threatening lump on breast
John Kloka - 47 - drinks !!! - wants to kill his son. At times says a devil is in him. ... sometimes is sorry - wants to be cured. . ...
Grace McCarten - 26 about - down T.B. 42 yrs. Now out on farm ... wonderful !
Mrs. H. Glasser - over 80 - Episcopelian - invalid, husband Lutheran 8- 58 yrs. married.
Lorain B. - 4 - brights-disease, terribly swollen
